_README: Tauri auto-updater manifest. Each `signature` is the raw text contents of the matching .sig file produced by `tauri build` when TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY is set. Each `url` must be a publicly downloadable artifact. Bump `version` and `pub_date` for every release. Platforms not listed get a 204 (no update) — see web/src/app/updater/[target]/[arch]/[current_version]/route.ts.
notes: Skillset 1.2.0 — user-friendly error handling with global toast notifications + Copy details, in-app updater check, and reliability fixes across chat, sync, auth, and settings.
